title: FILTER CLUSTERS BY AREA/VOLUME
description: Outputs a cifti file with nonzero integers for all brainordinates within a large enough cluster, and zeros elsewhere.  The integers denote cluster membership (by default, first cluster found will use value 1, second cluster 2, etc).  Cluster values are not reused across maps of the output, but instead keep counting up.  The input cifti file must have a brain models mapping on the chosen dimension, columns for .dtseries, and either for .dconn.  The ROI should have a brain models mapping along columns, exactly matching the mapping of the chosen direction in the input file.  Data outside the ROI is ignored.

surface_minimum_area.description: threshold for surface cluster area, in mm^2

volume_minimum_size.description: threshold for volume cluster size, in mm^3

direction.description: which dimension to use for spatial information, ROW or COLUMN

less_than.description: find values less than <value-threshold>, rather than greater

corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the surface

left_surface.description: specify the left surface to use

corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the surface

right_surface.description: specify the right surface to use

corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the surface

cerebellum_surface.description: specify the cerebellum surface to use

cifti_roi.description: search only within regions of interest

merged_volume.description: treat volume components as if they were a single component

surface_ratio.description: fraction of the structure's largest cluster area

volume_ratio.description: fraction of the structure's largest cluster volume

size_ratio.description: ignore clusters smaller than a given fraction of the largest cluster in the structure

surface_distance.description: how far from the largest cluster a cluster can be, edge to edge, in mm

volume_distance.description: how far from the largest cluster a cluster can be, edge to edge, in mm

distance.description: ignore clusters further than a given distance from the largest cluster in the structure

start.description: start labeling clusters from a value other than 1
